nodes.title: ProP-PD/PDZ-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina grouped explanatory schematic: C-terminal sequence identification → oligo library → peptide-phage display library; a separate plate-immobilized bait input feeds phage selection (arrow labeled Hybridize), followed by isolation/sequencing and peptide counts. The far-left Protein target/motif icon is introductory. There are no drawn alternative routes or retained unbound-phage branches. PMID 24550280 supports the proteome-derived ProP-PD implementation. PMID 20714644 supports a distinct PDZ-domain evolution/specificity-profiling study associated by the catalogue with PDZ-Seq; its full applicability to the depicted library-design route and plate format is unresolved. Only supplied abstracts, publication metadata, the catalogue text, and the actual diagram are used; neither primary full text was available in the supplied registry. This is an architecture description, not a complete protocol or a claim that the two names are aliases.
